population.justification: same long-term cavity-nesting bird study system; pied flycatcher and great tit are monitored in the same breeding population
population.exclusion_reason: caterpillar biomass peak is unavailable/anomalous in the published resource series; no imputation

migrant_timing.primary_variable: annual arithmetic mean of individual female nest-building start dates, used as the source-defined proxy for female arrival at Hoge Veluwe
migrant_timing.secondary_variable: calculated male arrival date; secondary lane only, never substituted into the primary lane after seeing outcomes
migrant_timing.aggregation_rule: unweighted arithmetic mean within calendar year, matching the source paper's annual-mean stage analysis; no median, quantile, first-arrival or model-derived replacement
migrant_timing.source_method_basis: Tomotani et al. 2018 Methods: female individual arrival proxied by start of nest building; analyses focused on annual means of each annual-cycle stage

resident_partner_timing.primary_variable: annual unweighted mean laying date of included first great-tit clutches

source_transport.primary: Dryad DOI/API metadata + Dryad individual bytes if accessible
source_transport.authoritative_fallback: Dryad full-dataset ZIP download; extract exact registered filename and record dataset/archive SHA-256 plus file SHA-256

digest_verified_public_mirror.use_rule: last-resort transport only if exact filename is present and computed SHA-256 equals an authoritative Dryad-declared SHA-256

destination_resource_state.primary_variable: annual observed peak date of caterpillar biomass

source_transport.primary: Dryad DOI/API metadata + Dryad individual bytes if accessible
source_transport.authoritative_fallback: Dryad full-dataset ZIP download; extract exact registered filename and record dataset/archive SHA-256 plus file SHA-256

digest_verified_public_mirror.use_rule: last-resort transport only if exact filename is present and computed SHA-256 equals an authoritative Dryad-declared SHA-256

precommitment_cue.source: NCEP/NCAR or source-faithful equivalent used by the already frozen CV24C cue reconstruction
precommitment_cue.primary_variable: Ivory Coast temperature, fixed 20-day mean beginning 18 February
precommitment_cue.spatial_rule: reuse the frozen 3x3 coarse-grid Ivory Coast proxy from PAYOFF_B_CV24C_CUE_DRIVER_RESULT_20260927; extend identically through 2015 using the same NCEP/NCAR source and transform

transport_amendment.reason: Dryad individual-file API/public file-stream routes returned HTTP 401/403 in GitHub Actions; Gate A therefore tries the Dryad full-dataset Open Access ZIP before any mirror
transport_amendment.scientific_effect: none; Dryad DOI and exact filenames remain authoritative; mirror bytes are accepted only with authoritative Dryad SHA-256 identity

inferential_amendment.timing: before Gate-A source outcome certification and before Gate-B/C outcomes are opened
inferential_amendment.reason: overlapping 8-year connectivity windows induce serial dependence; breakpoint search adds model flexibility; and decline/recovery branch is temporally ordered, so secular timing drift must be separated from branch/path dependence

migrant_aggregation_amendment.basis: published source Methods, before joined source outcome inspection

gate_order_amendment_20260928.timing: after source-access audit but before cue-resource connectivity/reversal outcome and before any focal/partner timing values are opened
gate_order_amendment_20260928.rationale: Gate B is defined only on the precommitment cue and destination resource. Requiring migrant/resident timing bytes before that independent environmental gate adds no protection against outcome tuning and unnecessarily couples Gate B to an external MDA access restriction.
gate_b_environmental_source_requirements: destination_resource_state exact file hash/schema/year coverage certified
gate_c_history_source_requirements: Gate B passes its frozen reversal and stability criteria
migrant_timing exact registered archive hash/schema/year coverage certified
resident_partner_timing exact file hash/schema/year coverage certified
gate_order_amendment_20260928.firewall: resident and migrant timing values remain unopened during Gate B; Gate C remains closed until both history sources are certified
gate_order_amendment_20260928.permitted_state: Gate B may run while migrant source access is blocked; Gate C may not

cue_resource_predictive_connectivity.processing: within each trailing window ending at t-1, separately linear-detrend cue and resource peak on year, then calculate signed Pearson rho

focal_partner_coordination.partner: annual mean first-clutch great-tit laying date
focal_partner_coordination.primary: signed calendar-day difference focal minus partner
focal_partner_coordination.note: a fixed stage offset does not affect branch contrasts; no post-hoc standardization or stage shifting is allowed

information_reversal_gate.algorithm: single interior breakpoint minimizing segmented linear SSE
information_reversal_gate.pass_rule: segmented AICc <= linear AICc - 4; pre-break slope < 0; post-break slope > 0; post-break endpoint recovers at least 50% of the pre-break-to-break decline; leave-one-history-year-out stability gate passes
information_reversal_gate.rule: focal and partner timing are not opened for hysteresis testing if this gate fails

aicc_parameter_count.segmented_components: two intercepts + two slopes + selected breakpoint

information_reversal_gate.breakpoint_tie_rule: if candidate segmented AICc values are numerically tied within 1e-12, choose the earlier break year
information_reversal_gate.serial_dependence_note: annual connectivity values are overlapping trailing-window estimates; AICc is used only as the predeclared geometry gate, not as an independent-year hypothesis test
information_reversal_gate.robustness_reporting: report all leave-one-history-year-out breakpoint, slope-sign and recovery diagnostics

leave_one_history_year_out_stability_gat.rule: history test remains closed if the full-sample geometry passes but this stability gate fails

information_reversal_gate.breakpoint_low_definition: predicted connectivity from the left/degradation line at the final pre-break target year
information_reversal_gate.recovery_endpoint_definition: predicted connectivity from the right/recovery line at the final registered target year
information_reversal_gate.loo_denominator_rule: all registered leave-one-history-year-out refits; a non-estimable refit counts as not preserving the criterion

history_test_if_reversal_passes.branch_definition: decline versus recovery branch defined only from the frozen cue-resource connectivity breakpoint
history_test_if_reversal_passes.overlap_support: restrict to the range of predictive-connectivity values observed on both branches
history_test_if_reversal_passes.primary_response: signed pied-flycatcher minus great-tit timing difference
history_test_if_reversal_passes.primary_support: HAC(7) 95% CI for the branch coefficient excludes zero at the mean overlapping connectivity after linear calendar-year adjustment
history_test_if_reversal_passes.secondary_support: report the unadjusted branch model, HAC(2), HC3 and interaction estimates/CIs without changing the primary criterion
history_test_if_reversal_passes.interpretation_if_supported: natural path dependence in resident-migrant seasonal coordination conditional on a recovered information coordinate
history_test_if_reversal_passes.interpretation_ceiling: does not identify the exact Nash mechanism, does not identify a natural rescue seed, and does not establish that either species intentionally acquires the declared temperature cue
history_test_if_reversal_passes.centering: within the decline/recovery overlap-support subset, center predictive connectivity at its mean and calendar year at its mean before fitting
history_test_if_reversal_passes.covariance: Newey-West HAC covariance, maxlags=7 (= window_years - 1), finite-sample correction
history_test_if_reversal_passes.covariance_rationale: adjacent 8-year trailing connectivity estimates share seven calendar years, so the primary covariance horizon is frozen at window_years - 1 before Gate-B/C outcomes are opened

time_trend_guard.rationale: decline and recovery branches occur at different calendar times; without an explicit secular-time term, ordinary long-term resident-migrant divergence can masquerade as branch/path dependence
time_trend_guard.interpretation_rule: a branch effect that appears only in the unadjusted model does not support natural path dependence

forbidden_moves: do not choose a different African temperature window from the focal or partner timing outcome
do not use the previously observed 2000/2001 CV24C selection-gradient breakpoint as this network breakpoint
do not use the published circa-2008 flycatcher interval reversal to choose regimes
do not impute the 1991 caterpillar peak
do not substitute male calculated arrival for female nest-building in the primary lane after seeing results
do not choose aggregation rules for great-tit laying date after inspecting mismatch
do not redefine a monotonic or one-way connectivity change as recovery hysteresis
do not promote a failed reversal gate to a history test
do not infer a natural singleton rescue species from this analysis
do not truncate the registered 1985-2015 source overlap after inspecting the cue-resource reversal
do not replace the registered annual arithmetic mean of female nest-building start dates with a median, quantile, first-arrival statistic or model-derived timing coordinate
do not interpret an unadjusted early-versus-late branch difference as path dependence if the preregistered year-adjusted branch coefficient is unsupported

relationship_to_prior_negative_lane.distinction: the prior lane tested African cue versus annual selection-gradient driver and had no partner timing; this contract prospectively tests African cue versus breeding-ground resource state and, only after an independent reversal gate, resident-migrant coordination history
relationship_to_prior_negative_lane.anti_retuning_rule: the new resource and partner coordinates were identified from independent published datasets and are frozen before their joined outcome is opened
